method: Absolute stock daily return minus SPY daily return; events mapped to the first available trading day on or after publication date; repeated events aggregated to one ticker/trading-day observation.
caveats: This is retrospective association, not evidence of predictive power or causation.
Daily close-to-close returns may include price movements before an event was published.
Multiple events on a ticker/trading day are aggregated; this does not remove all dependence between observations.
Events with no ticker or no usable price match are excluded.
